data_fields.name: base_tax_per_template
data_fields.donor_constant: Taxation.Tax (template value, not read in the file)

best_idea: Each plot holds a paid-through date that a payment extends and a server scan retires, with a warning window before lapse and a protection state that ends at the lapse, so the owner always sees the due date.
decision_why: Keep the paid-through clock, warning window and lapse scan; take the heavy-plot multiplier as zone data; fix the permission fall-through (defect 1), the hard-coded warning window, the payment base date and the build order (sketch).
acceptance: Server test: a Family-permission plot refuses a player with no family (donor admits them); a plot 6 days from lapse shows tax-due when the warning window is 7 days from config; a payment inside the 10 s window after lapse restarts from now; with three heavy plots the next weekly tax is 1.5 times base, rounded up; a build with a missing design charges no gold.
